turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I keep getting those pay later offers when I shop online.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: They're tempting. Do you want to stop using them completely, or set yourself a rule, like only one at a time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Wait a moment, my coworker is here. Please be quiet until I tell you I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, stop eating the croutons, they're for the salad.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You've quality checked half the tray.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: They're really good though. What did you put on them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Garlic, olive oil, a bit of parmesan. Can you pass me the lettuce from the fridge?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Which one, the round one or the long one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The long one. And wash your hands, you're all oily.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We'd got to the pay later thing. Decided on a rule?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One at a time. It's handy for big stuff.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Write the due date in your calendar the moment you use it.
